episodes.title: Le sept heures, mardi 6 octobre
episodes.headline_en: French secondary pupils march again across France on Tuesday: some 250,000 according to the authorities, 450,000 according to the organisers
summary_en: French secondary pupils march again across France on Tuesday: some 250,000 according to the authorities, 450,000 according to the organisers
Pupils' demonstrations multiply in Belgium, in Liège, Brussels, Mons, Charleroi and Arlon, according to RTBF
Arrests in Liège: RTBF says 33, La Libre counts 33 administrative and two judicial arrests, DH counts 31 administrative and two judicial

episodes.title: Le temps chez nous, mardi 6 octobre
episodes.headline_en: RTBF forecasts more sun and mild weather this Tuesday afternoon, with grey patches clearing in the west
summary_en: RTBF forecasts more sun and mild weather this Tuesday afternoon, with grey patches clearing in the west
Namur reaches 23 degrees today, with a low of 6, no rain expected and wind up to 8 km/h, according to the ECMWF model
